text:
jess: Heads-up — we have the infra apply in the release window for TGW route + IAM role pin. Deploybot shows a 22:00 UTC execute. Who's owning the apply and the escape hatch?

alex-m: I can own the apply. I'll be on standby at T-15m.

miguel: I'll handle the provider/module pin PR now. Planning to pin aws provider to 4.12.0 and module v2.3.1.

infra-oncall: Quick checklist: state snapshot + lock before apply, KMS key access verified, and preflight plan check passed.

jess: Good. miguel — please link the PR here when ready. Also we need an explicit rollback runbook.

miguel: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/pulls/482 — pins provider + adds canary variable. Waiting on one review.

sara-l: Verified KMS key access for the service accounts in prod and staging. No rotation needed.

deploy-bot: deploybot: scheduled terraform apply queued by jess for 2167894321. Preflight plan OK. Auto-lock will be enabled. ETA 25m.

alex-m: Apply owner here. My plan: run canary in prod with 10% route shift, watch latency and error rate for 15m, then 50% for 10m, then full. If any error >0.5% or latency p95 jump >200ms, abort and run rollback.

jess: Escape hatch (short version): 1) abort deploybot run 2) revert PR and run rollback apply with pinned state snapshot 3) fail traffic back to fallback region. Detailed commands below.

infra-oncall: Runbook snippet:```bash
# cancel running apply
deploybot cancel --run-id=release-2026-06-10-2167894321
# revert infra change (if already merged)
git revert <merge-commit> && git push origin main
# run rollback apply with saved state
TF_VAR_force_rollback=true make tf-apply ENV=prod LOCK=true
```

miguel: Added a state snapshot step to the CI: `ci/state-snapshot --env prod --name pre-release-2167894321`. Make sure we have that snapshot ID copied to the incident ticket if we abort.

alex-m: Copying the key metrics to watch: `infra.response_errors.total`, `infra.latency.p95`, `deploy.apply_errors`, `tgw.route-mismatch.count`. I will create a watch dashboard and set alerts to ping this thread.

sara-l: I'll be ready to rotate KMS or re-grant IAM if we hit permission issues. Keep me in the loop.

jess: Reminder — provider pin must be included in the apply branch otherwise drift may appear across regions. miguel confirmed PR link.

deploy-bot: deploybot: starting terraform apply (run-id=release-2026-06-10-2167894321) — owner=alex-m. Plan output posted to CI: https://ci.redwood/builds/7889

alex-m: Running apply now. Locking state.

infra-oncall: State locked by alex-m. Pre- and post- snapshots exist: pre=pre-release-2167894321, post will be created automatically.

alex-m: Canary applied, traffic shifted 10%. No errors in first 5m.

miguel: Observability: errors 0.02%, p95 +20ms. Good to continue to 50%.

alex-m: Shifting to 50% now. Keeping watch.

infra-oncall: Alert threshold not hit so far. All green.

jess: Remember to annotate the release notes with the provider pin and the tfstate snapshot IDs.

alex-m: Full rollout starting.

deploy-bot: deploybot: apply completed successfully (run-id=release-2026-06-10-2167894321). Summary: TGW routes updated, IAM role pins applied.

miguel: Merged PR and recorded provider/module pins in changelog.

sara-l: Verified KMS access post-apply. No action required.

jess: Great work team. Postmortem: small note — add a pre-apply smoke test against canary path next time to catch minor p95 spikes earlier.

alex-m: Agree. I'll add an automated smoke step in the apply pipeline.

infra-oncall: Closing the thread — saved snapshots: pre-release-2167894321, post-release-2167894321.

jess: Thanks everyone :tada:
